summary: A tools index (2,600px): a purple head with a circular photo, a muted grid of eight calculator cards and one closing contact strip. It is a utility page for lead generation, not a list of software.

sections.note: dark purple band; left: title and a four-line paragraph; right: a circular photo cropped with a pink arch behind and a coral dot.
pale blue ground; eight white cards in a 3-column grid, each with a pale icon tile, a bold two-line title and an outlined purple pill 'Calculate now'
purple strip about 190px: heading and a paragraph left, a round portrait with name, role and a coral 'book my time' button right
